title: Kaltura Experience Components Catalog
description: A2UI catalog for Kaltura Experience Components — Player v7, Flashcards, Media Manager, and more. Freestanding schema with all types inlined. Extends the basic A2UI catalog with rich media components backed by the Kaltura platform.

x-kaltura-adapters.description: Where tier-1 A2UI clients can load the renderers backing this catalog's components. Served by jsDelivr from the git tags of github.com/kaltura/kaltura-a2ui-components. Not on npm. In source, the tag and the SRI hashes are placeholders. The release workflow fills them in and commits the result only in the release commit the tag points to.

react.description: ESM bundle. React is an external peer — the host provides it. Register the Kaltura components by merging them into the host's catalog (see buildKalturaCatalog / kalturaReactCatalog). The module imports a second file, the SSR stub at stubCdn. Pin it with stubIntegrity too.

webcomponent.description: Self-contained IIFE (React inlined, CSS-in-JS). Drop in via <script> on plain-HTML hosts; registers all Kaltura custom elements on load. Verify with the integrity hash.

KalturaPlayer.description: Kaltura Player v7 — full-featured video player with DRM, multi-audio, 30+ plugins, captions, analytics tracking, ad insertion, and cue points. Renders as an iframe.

uiconfId.description: Player configuration ID (from KMC Studio or uiConf.list).

ks.description: Kaltura Session (KS). The host supplies it. Agents must never set this prop or ask for a KS. For hosts: use a USER KS (type=0) with only the privileges the Player guide lists, for example setrole:PLAYBACK_BASE_ROLE and sview:<entryId>.

autoplay.description: Auto-start playback. Requires muted=true per browser policy. Default: false.

muted.description: Start muted. Must be true when autoplay is true. Default: false.

startTime.description: Seek to this position (seconds) on load.

entryName.description: Optional entry name shown in the player title.

entryDescription.description: Optional entry description shown under the player. HTML tags are stripped.

KalturaFlashcards.description: Kaltura Flashcards — structured content cards with optional video clips for each card. Ideal for study material, topic summaries, and bite-sized learning derived from video content.

partnerId.description: Kaltura account/partner ID. Needed to play the clips.

uiconfId.description: Player configuration ID used to play the clips.

ks.description: Kaltura Session (KS). The host supplies it. Agents must never set this prop or ask for a KS. For hosts: use a USER KS (type=0) with only the privileges the Player guide lists, for example setrole:PLAYBACK_BASE_ROLE and sview:<entryId>.

summary.description: Brief summary or description of the flashcard deck.

clips.description: Video clips relevant to this card.

thumbnail.description: Optional thumbnail URL for the clip.

KalturaMediaManager.description: Kaltura Media Manager — browsable content library for selecting, previewing, and managing media entries. Supports category-scoped views, selection mode for embedding, and full management mode for content operations.

ks.description: Kaltura Session (KS). The host supplies it. Agents must never set this prop or ask for a KS. For hosts: use a USER KS (type=0) with only the privileges the Media Manager widget guide lists.

serverUrl.description: Kaltura Unisphere URL (e.g. 'https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1'). Only Kaltura Unisphere hosts are accepted (regions nvp1, irp2, frp2, cap2, syp2). Other hosts are refused.

theme.description: UI theme mode. Default: the host page's data-theme attribute, else 'dark'.

mode.description: Interaction mode. 'select' for content picking, 'manage' for full CRUD operations. Default: 'select'.

multiSelect.description: Allow picking up to 5 entries. Default: false.

contextId.description: ID of the content scope (e.g. category ID to browse).

KalturaAnalytics.description: Kaltura Analytics Dashboard — embedded KMC analytics iframe with optional entry, report type, and date range filters.

ks.description: Kaltura Session (KS). The host supplies it. Agents must never set this prop or ask for a KS. For hosts: the Analytics guide requires an ADMIN KS (type=2). The host must mint it on the server with a short TTL and narrow privileges, for example setrole and iprestrict.

entryId.description: Optional media entry ID to pre-filter the report.

reportType.description: Analytics report type to display on load.

fromDate.description: Start date for the analytics date range (ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD).

toDate.description: End date for the analytics date range (ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD).

KalturaCaptionsEditor.description: Kaltura Caption Studio — full-featured in-browser captions editor for a specific media entry.

ks.description: Kaltura Session (KS). The host supplies it. Agents must never set this prop or ask for a KS. For hosts: use a USER KS (type=0) with only the privileges the Captions Studio guide lists, including caption edit permission.

entryId.description: Media entry ID whose captions to edit.

uiconfId.description: Optional uiConf ID for the captions editor player.

KalturaRecorder.description: Kaltura Express Recorder — in-browser webcam/screen recording widget that uploads directly to the Kaltura account.

ks.description: Kaltura Session (KS). The host supplies it. Agents must never set this prop or ask for a KS. For hosts: use a USER KS (type=0) with only the privileges the Express Recorder guide lists, for example editadmintags:*.

uiconfId.description: Optional uiConf ID for the recorder widget.

KalturaAvatar.description: Kaltura Avatar: a live conversational AI agent with a video avatar, voice and captions, loaded through the Unisphere embeds API. The host's Kaltura Session picks the agent, so there is no agent or avatar ID prop. The browser asks the user for the microphone when a session starts.

serverUrl.description: Kaltura Unisphere URL (e.g. 'https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1'). Only Kaltura Unisphere hosts are accepted (regions nvp1, irp2, frp2, cap2, syp2). Other hosts are refused.

autoConnect.description: Start the session as soon as the avatar loads. Default: false, the user clicks to start.

openingPhrase.description: What the agent says first. Plain text. Default: the agent's own greeting.

captions.description: Show captions of what the agent says. Default: the agent's setting.

theme.description: Colour theme. Default: 'light' when the page has data-theme="light", otherwise 'dark'.

KalturaGenie.description: Kaltura Genie — AI-powered content discovery and Q&A widget backed by Unisphere.

ks.description: Kaltura Session (KS). The host supplies it. Agents must never set this prop or ask for a KS. For hosts: use a USER KS (type=0) with only the privileges the Genie widget guide lists, for example setrole:PLAYBACK_BASE_ROLE.

serverUrl.description: Kaltura Unisphere URL (e.g. 'https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1'). Only Kaltura Unisphere hosts are accepted (regions nvp1, irp2, frp2, cap2, syp2). Other hosts are refused.

categoryId.description: Optional category ID to scope the Genie content context.

KalturaContentLab.description: Kaltura Content Lab — AI-powered content creation and enrichment studio for media entries.

ks.description: Kaltura Session (KS). The host supplies it. Agents must never set this prop or ask for a KS. For hosts: use a USER KS (type=0) with only the privileges the Content Lab widget guide lists.

serverUrl.description: Kaltura Unisphere URL (e.g. 'https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1'). Only Kaltura Unisphere hosts are accepted (regions nvp1, irp2, frp2, cap2, syp2). Other hosts are refused.

entryId.description: Optional media entry ID to open Content Lab focused on a specific entry.

KalturaAgentsWidget.description: Kaltura AI Agents Widget — embedded Kaltura AI agents interface via Unisphere.

ks.description: Kaltura Session (KS). The host supplies it. Agents must never set this prop or ask for a KS. For hosts: use a USER KS (type=0) with only the privileges the Agents widget guide lists.

serverUrl.description: Kaltura Unisphere URL (e.g. 'https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1'). Only Kaltura Unisphere hosts are accepted (regions nvp1, irp2, frp2, cap2, syp2). Other hosts are refused.

agentId.description: Optional agent ID to launch a specific agent.

KalturaVodAvatar.description: Kaltura VOD Avatar — avatar overlay on a video-on-demand entry, powered by Unisphere.

ks.description: Kaltura Session (KS). The host supplies it. Agents must never set this prop or ask for a KS. For hosts: use a USER KS (type=0) with only the privileges the VOD Avatar widget guide lists.

serverUrl.description: Kaltura Unisphere URL (e.g. 'https://unisphere.nvp1.ovp.kaltura.com/v1'). Only Kaltura Unisphere hosts are accepted (regions nvp1, irp2, frp2, cap2, syp2). Other hosts are refused.

entryId.description: Media entry ID for the VOD content the avatar overlays.

KalturaChart.description: Kaltura Chart — data visualization component supporting 12 chart types: line, bar, area, pie, scatter, geo, wordcloud, treemap, heatmap, radar, sankey, funnel.

data.description: Array of data record objects. Keys used as x/y axes.

sourceData.description: Full dataset for table/export view when chart shows a summary subset.

title.description: Chart title displayed above the visualization.

xKey.description: Data key for the x-axis / category dimension. Auto-detected if omitted.

yKeys.description: Data keys for the y-axis / value dimensions. Auto-detected if omitted.

yLabels.description: Human-readable labels for the yKeys series (legend labels).

colors.description: Optional color overrides for chart series (hex or CSS color strings).

annotations.description: Vertical annotation markers on cartesian charts (line, bar, area, scatter).

color.description: Annotation color (hex or CSS). Default: accent color.

DataBinding.description: A reference to a value in the data model via JSON Pointer path.

path.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.

DynamicString.description: A string value — either a literal string or a data-binding reference.

DynamicNumber.description: A numeric value — either a literal number or a data-binding reference.

DynamicBoolean.description: A boolean value — either a literal boolean or a data-binding reference.

ComponentId.description: Unique identifier for a component instance within a surface.

AccessibilityAttributes.description: Attributes for assistive technologies (screen readers, etc.).

label.description: Short accessible label (1-3 words) conveying element purpose.

description.description: Additional context provided by assistive technologies.

ComponentCommon.description: Base properties shared by all components (from A2UI spec).

CatalogComponentCommon.description: Catalog-level properties shared by all Kaltura components.

theme.description: Full theme object for Kaltura surfaces. Includes palette, typography, shape tokens, and flashcard gradients so any A2UI renderer can apply consistent Kaltura branding.

primaryColor.description: Primary brand color (hex). Default: Kaltura Stream Blue #006EFA.

palette.description: Color palette tokens resolved per theme mode.

flashcardGradients.description: CSS gradient strings for flashcard card backgrounds. Cycled by card index.

anyFunction.description: Kaltura catalog does not define client-side functions.
